messages:
mira: Heads-up 1: we have two pilot customers asking for SLA exceptions and a custom burst plan. Need a compact exception runbook we can share with sales by EOD. Who can take the lead?

anya: I can collect the pilot asks and map required changes. key questions: duration (temporary vs permanent), metrics to adjust (availability vs latency), and billing tolerance.

sam: engineering concerns: we can offer a contracted 99.9% availability for Dedicated only, but that requires reserved capacity + fallback policy. otherwise we risk noisy neighbor incidents.

kyle: pricing side: we can do a "pilot burst allowance" for 30 days with predefined overage caps. finance needs a clear invoice line example and overage calc.

leo: ops: to make an exception safe we need two things: (1) automated fallback to smaller model variant on sustained degradation, and (2) a scoped canary + regional isolation during pilot.

mira: propose we create a one-page exception playbook: decision owner, approval window, technical mitigations, billing stub, and rollback trigger. Short + shareable.

eva: I'll add a docs stub with headings and a small sample invoice. can include a short code block showing invoice lines.

 dan-legal: legal: we can provide an addendum template but need exact SLA numbers and term length. please include a clause: "pilot exceptions are temporary and subject to capacity review".

sam: fallback draft snippet for runbook (ops will own wiring):
```
When p95 latency > 500ms for 5m in primary region:
  - Trigger: metric alert -> scale policy -> if scale fails after 2m, invoke fallback to variant v2-small for affected tenants.
  - Notify: page oncall and sales_ops channel.
  - Revert when p95 < 350ms for 10m.
```

leo: add to that: automatic quota cap for burst tokens at tenant level (soft cap + warning, hard cap enforced after opt-in limit).

anya: commercial flow suggestion:
- Sales files request (template)
- Finance approves provisional numbers
- Legal issues addendum
- Product signs off on mitigations
- Ops schedules canary and enables exception
- Post-pilot review within 14 days

mira: perfect. assign owners? anya collects asks + sales template. kyle + finance draft invoice example. dan-legal to prepare addendum template. sam + leo to own fallback & canary. eva to draft docs.

kyle: I'll draft a sample invoice and a short pricing table showing reserved vs burst vs overage. will mark numbers as PROVISIONAL and include example math.

dan-legal: ETA: addendum draft by tomorrow morning. need final SLA line (availability %) from product.

sam: ETA: fallback runbook + RFC by EOD tomorrow. canary pipeline slot requested.

leo: ETA: quota guard + alert wiring in 48h. will also add the regional isolation playbook.

eva: ETA: docs stub + sample invoice PR by EOD today. link when ready.

oncall-bot: Reminder: if you page after hours, follow oncall playbook.

mira: ok sync at 3pm to review the one-pager before we hand to sales. keep things terse. :white_check_mark:

anya: acked. I'll also include a quick checklist sales can use when they're talking to pilots.

kyle: ack. finance will be on the 3pm sync.

sam: ack.

leo: ack.
